verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a `cognee-cli report` command that writes a Graph Insight Report on a dataset's graph. It also documents asking questions over stored memory via recall/CLI, with search available in the browser UI. That is first-party support for getting insights from your data, but the docs do not say whether the report is LLM-generated, and nothing covers proactive suggestions. Missing for 10: proactive AI suggestions, evidence that the insight report is AI-generated and available in the UI, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: `cognee-cli report` writes a Graph Insight Report describing what a dataset's graph contains
The cognee-cli command lets you run Cognee from the terminal so you can remember data, enrich memory, and ask questions without opening a Python file.
